name: Markus Reinhardt
headline: Lead Backend Engineer
summary: Backend engineering leader with 11 years of experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments. Skilled in leading cross-functional teams, driving Kubernetes-based infrastructure adoption, and delivering resilient Java-based microservices on AWS. Passionate about mentoring engineers and improving system reliability.

responsibilities: Lead a team of 8 backend engineers building microservices for a logistics platform
Define technical architecture and roadmap for backend systems on AWS
Drive adoption of Kubernetes for container orchestration across services
Mentor engineers through code reviews and technical design discussions
Collaborate with product and infrastructure teams to plan scalable solutions
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for e-commerce backend services
Migrated monolithic application to microservices architecture
Set up CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and deployment
Optimized database queries improving response times for high-traffic endpoints
Developed backend services for internal enterprise applications
Implemented unit and integration tests to ensure code quality
Collaborated with frontend team to define API contracts
Participated in agile sprint planning and code reviews
